name: VPS Monitor
author: sahils
description: Health and security stats for one VPS over SSH inside a WireGuard tunnel, with buttons to connect the tunnel and open a terminal on the server.

barWidget.description: VPS health and security at a glance; click for stats, Connect and Monitor.

schema.label: WireGuard connection
schema.description: Name of the NetworkManager WireGuard connection (nmcli connection show).

schema.label: SSH host
schema.description: Host alias from ~/.ssh/config. It must log in with a key, without a password prompt.
